Name: JavascriptPivotFilter
Content:
<![CDATA[
function remove$GridReport$Filter(g) {
  var r = name, field;
  for (var j = g._filter.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
    var x = g._filter[j].match(/^([\w\$]+):/)[1];
    name = $func.trim(x);
    field = $func.findField(name, g._fields);
    if (x.indexOf('$') != -1) {
      if (field) field.FilterPanelValue = '';
      Array.removeAt(g._filter, j);
    }
  }
}

function onSelectionOutlineEntry(o, type) {
  if ((!$func.isCs) && (!$func.isFF)) return;
  if (type) Sys.UI.DomElement.addCssClass(o, 'SelectionOutline');
    else Sys.UI.DomElement.removeCssClass(o, 'SelectionOutline');
}
function changeLookupReadonly(f, c, force) {
  if (force && !$func.isFF) return;
  var o = f.getItem(c);
  f._setReadOnly(o, false);
  if ($func.isIF) o.readOnly = false; else {
    if (!force) try {
      $removeHandler(o, 'keydown', f._readOnlyKeyHandler);
      if ($func.isOpr) $removeHandler(o, 'keypress', f._readOnlyKeyHandler);
      o.AddReadOnlyKeyHandler = null;
    } catch (ex) {}
  }
  if (force && $func.isFF) $addHandler(o, 'keydown', f._readOnlyKeyHandler);
}

Name: ScriptQueryFilterString
Content:
<![CDATA[
function getQueryFilterString(f, s) {
  var q = '', a = s.split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var c = $func.trim(a[i]), o = f.getItem(c), v = (o ? f.getItemValue(c) : c);
    q += String.fromCharCode(253);
    if (o) {
      switch (o.field.Type) {
        case 'DateTime':
          q += v ? $func.formatDateOrder(v) : 'null';
          break;
        case 'Boolean':
          q += (v ? '1' : '0');
          break;
        case 'Int16':
        case 'Int32':
        case 'Int64':
        case 'Decimal':        
          q += (v);
          break;
        default:
          q += $func.replace(v, '\'', String.fromCharCode(252));
          break;
      }
    } else q += $func.replace(v, '\'', String.fromCharCode(252));
  }
  return q;
}
]]>
